combo_u.estimator: source-target intercepts plus two common ridge-penalized slopes
combo_u.inner_selection: leave-one-source-target-out; equal-target macro mean log loss; 1e-12 ties choose larger lambda
combo_u.standardization: weighted mean and population SD from each current source/inner training set only

adaptation.scope: linear U only, both source weighting schemes and all analysis-set/cluster-rule combinations
adaptation.base_prediction: eta_U is fixed from the corresponding LOTO source model before target-internal adaptation; never refit the source model using target adaptation labels
adaptation.I_model: eta_I=a+eta_U; fit only intercept a on each outer adaptation-training set by weighted-free maximum likelihood/root solving; all adaptation pairs have equal weight
adaptation.F_penalty: minimize mean negative log-likelihood on the adaptation-training rows + 0.5*lambda*delta^2; intercept a is unpenalized and delta=0 corresponds exactly to unchanged U slope
adaptation.adaptation_training_weight: 1 per pair for both source-weighting variants; source weighting affects only the fixed U base model
adaptation.lambda_selection: for each lambda, fit F on every inner-training split and concatenate all inner-validation predictions; choose the lambda with minimum pooled inner-validation log loss using probability_clip; if values tie within 1e-12, choose the larger lambda; Brier is not the selection metric
adaptation.final_outer_fit: refit a and delta with selected lambda on the full outer adaptation-training set and predict its untouched outer test split
adaptation.failure_rule: if inner folds cannot be formed, an inner-training set has one class, a candidate fails QC, or the final fit fails, record the affected lambda/fold as unevaluable; if all lambdas fail, predictive F is unevaluable; never use outer test labels to repair or select
adaptation.required_comparisons: on identical outer-test rows compare U, predictive I and predictive F; include Brier, log loss, BSS-adaptation-train, BSS-target-oracle and the same target's original BSS-transport
adaptation.aggregation: save outer-fold metrics and concatenate each target's five outer-test prediction sets for target-level out-of-fold metrics; adaptation-train baselines remain fold-specific row by row

forbidden: modify v1/v2/v3, frozen master, clusters, folds, Pinc extension, or prior results
network, install, upgrade, RQ6, random forest, other ML, ipSAE, LIS, extra feature search
change outcomes, features, lambda, weights, folds, or analysis sets based on results
claim population uncertainty over future targets or rewrite RQ3 conclusions
